title: OnboardingComputeIntent (DESIGN.md §7.4; §16.6 item 12; family contract R32)
description: The §7.4 field list verbatim: the Society-authorized one-shot hosted model call for a dormant candidate. It binds Kovee's final provider bytes, DisclosureManifest, provider/model/region/retention, metered budget, candidate fence, and output-only operations; it grants no tool, network, workspace, child, or reusable Participant authority. Starting the compute is the Society's invitation, not the candidate's assent; silence or failure expires and never becomes acceptance (§7.4). Consumed exactly once through onboarding_compute_permit_consume (R32: Kovee model broker bound to this exact intent, workload mTLS, one-shot key + onboarding fence). Kovee owns the host schema; this is the byom-normative shape.

onboarding_ref.description: The exact OnboardingActivationOffer (§7.4; machine spec/descriptors/onboarding-activation-offer.json — at most one compute use per offer, referenced, never re-owned).

society_id.description: §7.4 names this member society_id (not society_ref); transcribed verbatim.

provider_context_manifest_ref.description: Kovee's FINAL ProviderContextManifest (§16.6 item 12: through Kovee's final manifest and model broker).

retention_and_training_claims.description: §7.4 pins presence but no value shape (recorded gap — slice-2 gap notes); carried as an opaque ref to the provider retention/training claims record.

allowed_output_operations.description: §7.4 verbatim, including `refuse` where the operation catalog and OnboardingActivationOffer.allowed_operations say `membership_refuse` (recorded gap — slice-2 gap notes); output may only drive these, and runtime output is never membership assent (§16.6 item 12).

tools_network_workspace_children.description: §7.4 verbatim: no tool, network, workspace, or child authority, ever.

authorized_by_decision_ref.description: The Society decision funding the invitation (§7.4: the Society's invitation/disclosure authority, never candidate assent).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.
